verdict.rationale: Canny publishes a dedicated public API Reference on its developer portal (developers.canny.io/api-reference), alongside developer install docs and an llms.txt index that machine clients can read. That is the core of a documented public API. However, the evidence is only the page title: no endpoints, auth model, or write coverage are shown, and the probe found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: evidence of API endpoint coverage and auth details, an OpenAPI/Swagger spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
